name: Ferrotec Corporation
summary: Ferrotec Corporation engages in semiconductor equipment-related, electronic device, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers thermo-electric modules; thermistors; power electronic substrates; ferrofluid; vacuum seals; quartz; silicon parts; ceramics; SiC parts; silicon wafers; parts cleaning; and reclaim wafer.
